question: What is the hero's full name with the highest attribute in strength?
evidence: highest attribute in strength refers to MAX(attribute_value) WHERE attribute_name = 'strength';
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T1.full_name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC) AS __r FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Strength') AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Strength' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

d.request: Which hero, identified by full name, has the highest strength attribute (the MAX attribute_value where attribute_name = 'strength'), and if multiple heroes tie for that highest value, return all of them?
d.sql: SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength')

b.request: Return the full names of all superheroes whose strength attribute_value equals the maximum strength attribute_value (attribute_name = 'strength'), including every hero tied for that highest value
b.sql: SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength')
